listing.name: Arx Fatalis (Arx Libertatis)
listing.summary: Windows prepared-player route: use a complete permitted Arx Libertatis1.2.1 copy after upstream-supported original/demo data preparation. Preserve separate data, user and config roots and existing migration choices. Core offers nonowning registration/Play; upstream owns setup, profile writes and replacement, without original or managed save qualification.

steps.title: Keep the complete native Arx player
steps.instruction: Use an already permitted complete Arx Libertatis1.2.1 Windows installation or ZIP, including compatible libraries/resources. Select arx.exe directly, not arxtool, arxsavetool, arxunpak, a crash reporter or installer. Normal GUI entry runs the game in that process; a diagnostic/crash helper is a separate upstream process and is not adopted by Core.

steps.title: Finish upstream data preparation first
steps.instruction: Use your own permitted supported full Arx Fatalis data or separately permitted demo with the upstream preparation path for that edition/language. The reviewed installer script distinguishes CD/ISO preparation needing1.21 patch data, already installed/GOG alternatives, Japanese and demo branches; do not mix their data sets or assume one minimal PAK list. Finish the upstream setup and normal start/quit before registration. Core invokes no extraction/patch/helper and grants no original/demo asset rights.

steps.title: Preserve the established directory choices
steps.instruction: Use the actual prepared working directory and existing supported literal data/user/config arguments. Actual Windows Saved Games/Arx Libertatis (older Documents/My Games fallback), registry UserDir/DataDir, config dir, executable/data search and custom/environment roots can differ. Keep established --data-dir/--user-dir/--config-dir values where used. The documented --no-data-dir --user-dir=. --config-dir=. portable combination is an existing upstream option, not a command to move your profile or force a new one. Review intent/consent and choose Play separately.

steps.title: Retain all state before upstream writes or migration
steps.instruction: Preserve complete runtime, original/demo data, actual user/config/data roots, cfg.ini, saves, screenshots, mods, logs, crash reports and unknown/custom/legacy files. First use can lowercase used files in the user tree; startup prunes old crash reports and writes logs. Keep a recoverable old copy before those upstream operations. No actual save roundtrip or harmless read-only startup is promised. Engine GPL3+ and component/additional terms remain separate from original data rights.

steps.title: Keep replacement and removal ownership clear
steps.instruction: Close all real instances before external file changes. Upstream/player owns preparation, runtime replacement, profile writes and any migration/recovery. Preserve the old creating copy and every actual data root, finish deliberate replacement upstream and review/relink the changed player before the next Play. Core observes only its separately consented selected process, not an exclusive instance family or sandbox, and does not adopt unrelated helpers/successors. Registration-only removal preserves all external files. No Core-managed acquisition/setup/update/backup/rollback/migration/deletion is offered by this route.

warnings: This guide adds no Supported promotion, original/component permission, acquired-source-to-binary or private-output certificate. Use only a copy and content you are already permitted to use.
Source/API and inert native probes are distinct from actual game/save/mod/network, installed Desktop, physical/human, other-platform or protected acceptance. No such new observation is claimed.
Keep complete actual external runtime and player-data roots recoverable before upstream changes; another player folder does not guarantee independent shared state.
